wholePhysicalScope: The mapped outer and courtyard rings control the standing complex. Historic frontage position and proportions follow the photographed portico and flanking classical colonnades.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the Ionic entrance, stepped garden facade, hipped roofs and four open courts.
limitations: The model represents the standing museum. Roof heights, less visible courtyard and rear elevations, sculptural figures and small details are estimates from the available evidence.
The original terrain is a 30 m surface dataset. Small steps and vegetation are below its resolution.
